title: ihris-ig-build-patches/v1
description: Fixes applied to a WORKSPACE copy of a sub-instance's declared IG source before it is built (src/tools/apply_ig_patches.py, used by build_ihris5_ig.sh and map_ihris5.py). A patch either replaces one exact text, exactly once, or copies one file of the same pinned source into the workspace (`copyFrom`); the mounted source and the upstream are never edited. Each entry is an upstream defect to report, removed when the pinned source fixes it.

source.description: owner/repo@commit the patches were written against: must equal the sub-instance's declared source.

id.description: a short stable name, recorded where the patch is applied (e.g. in the F4 element index)

base.description: what `file` and `copyFrom` are relative to: the declared source path (default, e.g. ig/) or the repository root (for the other IGs in the same repository)

copyFrom.description: a file of the same pinned source, copied to `file` (which must not exist)

upstream.description: where the defect is reported or drafted
